svg.title: Blue Relief with Black
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-recent-paintings-10-1994/lightbox/works/blue-relief-with-black-1993-2473; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
